name: Royal Selangor Pewter Cup
about: Malaysian pewter is a craft tied to Kuala Lumpur, where Royal Selangor has made it since the 1800s. Its tin-based metal is shaped and polished by hand.
tip: Check whether the model is safe for food and drink use before you buy.

name: Malaysian Batik Scarf
about: Batik is a wax-resist dyeing craft widely practiced in Malaysia. It makes a lightweight, colorful souvenir that reflects local textile traditions.
tip: Ask whether it is hand-dyed or digitally printed, since both are sold and the prices differ.

name: BOH Cameron Highlands Tea
where: Isetan food hall or supermarkets that carry BOH
about: BOH is a well-known Malaysian tea brand grown in the Cameron Highlands, a cool hill region north of Kuala Lumpur. It is an easy, lightweight gift to take home.
tip: Choose loose leaf over scented blends if you want the pure tea flavor.
